question: Which state had the lowest chronic liver disease mortality rate in 2022? (A) Pennsylvania (B) New York (C) California. Answer with just the letter.
description: MT attack on the public_health line chart. All series are drawn in near-identical blues, so series are hard to tell apart. Misleader from Lo et al., 'Misinformed by Visualization' (EuroVis 2022): ineffective color scheme. True answer: B (New York). Bait: A (Pennsylvania).
